family.name: Free-Energy Moment-Onsager reduction
family.dynamic_state: Per retained layer: integrated water storage S_i and centered first water-content moment M_i.
family.profile_principle: Unique minimum-capillary-free-energy profile subject to the retained S_i,M_i and frozen constitutive bounds.
family.propagation_principle: Project the standard Richards energy-dissipation/Onsager principle onto the retained moment manifold.

richards_gradient_structure.isolated_energy_identity: dE/dt=-integral q^2/K(theta) dz <= 0, apart from boundary work when flux/head is imposed.
richards_gradient_structure.convexity: On a strictly monotone retention branch, F''(theta)=-dpsi/dtheta>0.

constraints: theta_lo <= theta(z) <= theta_hi on the frozen constitutive interval
local_moment_manifold.variational_definition: theta_i^*(S_i,M_i)=argmin integral_I F(theta(z)) dz subject to the two moment constraints and bounds.
local_moment_manifold.gravity_note: The gravitational term -integral z*theta dz equals -(z_c*S_i+M_i), so it is constant when S_i and M_i are fixed. Local profile selection therefore minimizes capillary energy only.
local_moment_manifold.existence: For a nonempty closed bounded feasible moment set, the direct method gives a minimizer.
local_moment_manifold.uniqueness: Strict convexity of F makes the minimizer unique over the convex feasible set.
local_moment_manifold.interior_kkt: Where neither constitutive bound is active, F'(theta)+lambda_0+lambda_1*(z-z_c)=0, hence psi(theta(z))=lambda_0+lambda_1*(z-z_c).
local_moment_manifold.interpretation: The unique unconstrained local profile is affine in suction, not affine/cubic in theta and not logistic-information-entropy BEMR.
local_moment_manifold.active_bound_case: If a bound activates, the same strictly convex obstacle problem remains unique; numerical regularity/conditioning must be qualified.

reduced_onsager_dynamics.profile_map: theta^*(z;a) assembled from the unique layer minimizers.
reduced_onsager_dynamics.continuity_constraint: dq/dz = -dtheta/dt plus volumetric sources where present.
reduced_onsager_dynamics.global_flux_property: A single integrated q(z) is used across the column, so mass flux is globally conservative and does not require separate left/right interface flux branches.
reduced_onsager_dynamics.rayleighian: R_r(a_dot)=Phi(a,a_dot)+grad(E_r) dot a_dot - external boundary power, subject to the selected boundary constraints.
reduced_onsager_dynamics.stationarity: Minimizing R_r gives a finite-dimensional generalized gradient-flow system G(a)*a_dot = driving(a,boundary), with G a symmetric resistance Gram matrix.
reduced_onsager_dynamics.uniqueness_condition: If K>0 and the tangent modes are independent after applying the boundary/mass constraints, G is positive definite on the admissible rate subspace and the instantaneous reduced rate is unique.
reduced_onsager_dynamics.exact_projected_moment_balance: Because q is linked to the tangent state by continuity, the C5Y storage and first-moment balance identities follow automatically from integration; no empirical moment relaxation law is introduced.

boundary_semantics.prescribed_flux: Flux values enter as boundary constraints/affine terms in the continuity-integrated q field, not as a nonlinear static profile root.
boundary_semantics.prescribed_head: Head/potential enters through the standard boundary-work/natural-boundary term of the Onsager functional; the exact reduced discrete form requires mathematical qualification before response.
boundary_semantics.significance: FEMO does not reuse the C6E BEMR prescribed-flux algebraic system and therefore is not a post-result successful-start selection or solver repair.

distinction_from_closed_routes.BEMR: BEMR used a cubic information-entropy dual profile and enforced storage, moment and hydraulic conditions in one static nonlinear profile solve. FEMO uses a unique physical capillary-energy moment manifold plus dynamic minimum-dissipation projection; no cubic dual or C6E branch solve remains.
distinction_from_closed_routes.DSE2P: No assumption that unresolved layers are instantaneously steady with constant Darcian flux.
distinction_from_closed_routes.C6F_C6G: No fixed added physical sub-control volume; the additional scalar is the conservation-derived first moment already established in C5Y.

why_not_post_c6e_retuning: The capillary free-energy density is fixed by the same retention relation already present in Richards physics.
The hydraulic dissipation q^2/K is fixed by Darcy-Buckingham mobility.
The S,M state was derived in C5Y before BEMR response.
No term, coefficient, bound, monitor, start rule or penalty is chosen from the five C6E failure cases.
C6E BEMR equations are abandoned rather than repaired.

independent_theory_context.citation: Cancès, C. (2018), Energy stable numerical methods for porous media flow type problems, Oil & Gas Science and Technology 73, 78.
independent_theory_context.relevance: Shows porous-media equations including Richards-type flow as generalized gradient flows of a capillary/gravitational energy with mobility-driven dissipation.

independent_theory_context.citation: Kou, J. and Wang, X. (2024), Numerical modeling of unsaturated flow in porous media using a thermodynamical approach, Capillarity 11(3), 63-69.
independent_theory_context.relevance: Provides a thermodynamically consistent Richards formulation driven by chemical-potential gradients and an energy-dissipation law.

independent_theory_context.citation: Akman Yildiz, T., Uzunca, M., Karasözen, B. (2019), Structure preserving reduced order modeling for gradient systems, Applied Mathematics and Computation 347, 194-209.
independent_theory_context.relevance: Independent ROM literature supports preserving an underlying gradient/dissipation structure during model reduction; it does not establish FEMO hydrological fidelity.

next_authority.question: Can the physical free-energy S/M manifold and its projected Onsager resistance operator be evaluated uniquely, smoothly and with a positive-definite constrained metric over the frozen B14 moment domain and both boundary classes before any hydrological trajectory?
constraints: Use the unchanged C6C/C6E B14 S/M synthetic domains; no response-derived narrowing.
Use F'(theta)=-psi(theta) from the frozen B14 retention relation; no fitted energy term.
Qualify local moment-profile existence, uniqueness, bound activity, moment recovery and conditioning.
Construct tangent sensitivities and the Onsager resistance Gram matrix; require symmetry and positive definiteness on the admissible rate subspace.
Derive prescribed-flux and prescribed-head boundary power/operators before evaluating them.
No time trajectory, no C6D/C6E response metrics, no free-running FEMO, no performance claim.
If the reduced metric or boundary operators are not well posed, stop without regularization chosen from the result.
